scope: Untrusted serialized object payloads sent to deserializers that can trigger gadget chains.
label_rule: Deciding evidence: parser_context. Keep serialized-object-looking content (Java rO0 / AC ED, PHP O:n:, pickle, .NET); make it legitimate: a developer feature (artifact store, debug capture upload, cache inspector) stores it as an opaque blob and never deserializes it; the parser context shows no deserializer on that path.
